summary: Log in with flightctl login https://<host>:3443 --token=<aap-token> for the automatic setup (a Read-scope personal token works) or --web --client-id=<id> for the manual setup; --insecure-skip-tls-verify only without valid certs. flightctl version shows CLI and server versions, which must match.
questions: How do I log in to Red Hat Edge Manager with the CLI?
flightctl login with an AAP token
Does the flightctl version need to match the Edge Manager version?

answer_card.title: flightctl login
answer_card.answer_md:
Automatic OAuth setup (personal token, Read scope is enough):
```bash
flightctl login https://<edge-manager-host>:3443 --token=<aap-oauth-token> --insecure-skip-tls-verify
```
Manual OAuth setup (browser approval):
```bash
flightctl login https://<edge-manager-host>:3443 --web --client-id=<aap-client-id> --insecure-skip-tls-verify
```
Drop `--insecure-skip-tls-verify` once you have valid certificates. `flightctl version` must show matching CLI and server versions.
